title: 3.0.0.2-dev-l: mmol/l / mg/dl bug
symptom: In AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-l, when using the bolus calculator with mmol/l settings, the blood glucose value is stored in Nightscout treatments as mg/dl instead of mmol/l. Also, after entering a value in mmol/l, the overview screen may show the value in mg/dl, and switching units too fast causes a screen error with mixed mmol/l and mg/dl stripes.
cause: The issue is on the Nightscout side; it does not convert the value to the units selected in settings. The upload was always in mg/dl.
fix: A commit was made to upload at least in the units selected in AAPS (commit 70f365960052ec28f6844538559c8cd38bf32220). A workaround for the screen error is to exit the app and restart after switching units.
evidence_quote: issue is on NS side. it doesn't convert value to units selectwed in settings. I set at least upload to units selected in AAPS
